in_marathi.name: Ambrish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambrish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ambhu’ meaning water and ‘rish’ meaning master or sage. This name signifies one who is immortal or imperishable, a wise and enlightened soul. In Hindu mythology, Ambrish is the name of a sage who had the power to control the elements of water and fire.
